t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The colour of the gnomes and baskets will change throughout the game. The red gnome will have a red basket and blur gnome blue basket, for example. You will start to see which one collects the most mushrooms.

vb_textbox.text:
There are two shapes of gnomes, these do not matter. There are two basket colours, red and yellow. Each coloured gnome will always have the same coloured basket. For example, blue always has yellow and red always has red.
When the screen shows 1x points use this as a way of judging which basket collects the most mushrooms. Anything more than 3 mushrooms means it's a good basket for the next few rounds. I would keep selecting that coloured basket until the numbers fall below 3 mushrooms.
For example, select the red gnome for a red basket and you may get 5 mushrooms. The next round it's the safest bet to select the purple gnome for another red basket. If you get less mushrooms the next round, choose the yellow basket.
